svg.title: How Bias Enters a Model
svg.desc: Training data contains bias. The model learns and internalizes that bias, produces skewed or discriminatory outputs, and creates business, legal and ethical risk. Mitigation with diverse data, human feedback (RLHF) and continuous evaluation acts on the training data and the model, and is triggered by the risk it reduces.
svg.text: Bias flows down the chain; mitigation intervenes at the data and the model.
